Policy_Identity.title: RECORD developer policy-decision recording and storage

exclusions: MPD-RECORD-0003 owns decisions concerning work-plan documents; its rules do not inherit automatically from this policy.
Creating new decision, approval, or execution authority from the existence or structural validation of a record.
Treating these recording principles as completed implementation or activation of a missing service schema, binding contract, or verifier.

Boundary.scope: Recording and storage of user decisions concerning Kinirin/PTSIP developer policy documents, with recording integration that preserves existing contract structures
subjects: Record user decisions concerning developer policies. Decisions may be stored in the policy document itself or in a separate record file; the policy document is the default storage location.
Use a structured recording contract for decisions stored in policy documents. Preserve the user's contract structure and identity, and limit changes to the minimum needed for reference integration.

When only a common policy contract exists, reference the policy-decision record schema from that common contract. By default, maintain the record schema in a separate file distinguishable from the user's contract file; the user may request a merge.

When only independent policy contracts exist, assess each contract's role, responsibility, and recording needs, and add a record-schema reference only to contracts that need it. Do not force the creation of a common parent policy contract merely for recording.

By default, recommend one recording-service schema referenced by the independent contracts. Sharing a subordinate recording-service contract does not establish a common policy contract structure. The user may request a separate record schema for each independent contract.

When common and independent policy contracts coexist, identify the actual owner of the policy-content field. Reference the record schema from the common contract when it owns that field, or from the relevant independent contracts when only those contracts own the field.

When both contract structures coexist, strongly recommend references to one recording-service schema and discourage a separate decision-record structure for every independent contract. Do not require a reference in contracts whose roles and responsibilities do not need recording.

Separating decisions from the policy document requires record verification and policy reference rules. Keep policy-decision record schema contracts under .ptsip/contracts/Decision_Record/policy/ and decision-record data under .ptsip/context/.

For separate records, connect the necessary policy-contract binding through a path and a unique ID with a SHA256 pattern. Write decision details in the designated record file and display a short constant name in the policy document for convenience.

A constant name is a user-facing identification aid, not evidence of decision meaning. Do not infer a decision from its name; resolve the unique ID and inspect the actual decision content before making a determination.

Do not invent unresolved record or binding fields, the generation and change semantics of a SHA256-pattern ID, or detailed verification procedures. Request user review when a conflict or problem arises.

Boundary.scope: Release-note record units, file patterns, namespaces, and composition-contract and verifier locations for Kinirin/PTSIP development
subjects: The Package note file pattern is docs/releasenote/PTSIP_Package/{package_version}.md.
The per-engine note file pattern is docs/releasenote/engine/{engine}/{engine}-engine-{version}.md.
Combining notes for multiple engines into one merged note file is forbidden.
The release-note record namespaces are tool, project-profile, PTSIP_Package, and engine.
Verifiers that perform release-note validation or reference checks belong under .ptsip/engine/developer/Distribution/release/.
Resolve release-note composition contracts under .ptsip/contracts/release/; other locations are not canonical locations for those composition contracts.
Leave details not included in this declaration unresolved, and request user review when a conflict or problem arises.
